name: interpn
comment: Sig: V = interpn(X1,...,Xn, V, Xq1,...,Xqn). r1 = 3-D ndgrid Form B (dispatches interp3). r2 = 1-D grid-vector query interpn(X,V,Xq) (delegates to interp1; was NaN, bugs/math/interpn-nan). r4 = 1-D vector query + method. NB interpn(V) / interpn(V,ntimes) grid-refinement and 4+-D are separate parity gaps (NOT covered here). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b.
